description: Summarize a wallet’s recent confirmed signature activity with success and failure counts and the newest signature. This does not decode transaction instructions. Example: {"wallet":"Brpc8HoPo1d3Uiyo7kbERnjMqwLJJmbWxtwxHxzar6DU","limit":20} Cost: 3 free calls, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402. Calls that return an error are not charged.

limit.description: Number of newest signatures to examine, from 1 to 100 (default 20).

network.description: Solana cluster to query. Use mainnet-beta for real assets or devnet for test data; defaults to mainnet-beta.

wallet.description: Wallet or program address in Base58 format (32–44 characters).

name: summarize_wallet_activity
